chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Abu Ja'far, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, who said:
I said to Abī Ibrāhīm عليه السلام: Is sadaqat al-fitrah due upon a needy man? He said: There is no fitrah due upon him.

key_terms.صَدَقَةُ ٱلْفِطْرَةِ: the alms of fitrah due at the end of Ramadan
key_terms.لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ: it is not incumbent upon him
key_terms.ٱلْمُحْتَاجِ: the needy person who lacks sufficient means

ai.seo_question: Is sadaqat al-fitrah obligatory on a poor or needy person?
ai.summary: This hadith states that sadaqat al-fitrah is not obligatory upon a poor or needy person. It serves as a jurisprudential basis for the ruling that fitrah falls from one who lacks sufficient means.
